text: 1、市场早间震荡走强，三大指数均涨超1%。军工板块集体爆发，航发科技4天3板，长城军工、金奥博、晨曦航空等涨停。低空经济概念大幅走强，华力创通、金盾股份、广联航空、万丰奥威等多股涨停。房地产板块反弹，我爱我家、新城控股、深物业A、天健集团等涨停。创新药概念拉升，莱美药业、泓博医药、尖峰集团、中恒集团等涨停。下跌方面，PCB概念股调整，四会富仕跌超10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4800股飘红，上午半天成交9710亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.95%，深成指涨1.19%，创业板涨0.96%。 2、板块概念方面，军工、低空经济、房地产、创新药等板块领涨；PCB、游
text_en: 1. The market fluctuated and strengthened in the morning, with all three major indexes rising more than 1%. The defense sector surged collectively, with Hangfa Technology notching 3 limit-ups in 4 days, while Great Wall Military Industry, Jin'aobo, and Chenxi Aviation hit the limit up. The low-altitude economy concept strengthened sharply, with Huahong Chuangtong, Jindun Co., Guanglian Aviation, Wanfeng Auto, and many other stocks hitting the limit up. The real estate sector rebounded, with 5i5j, Seazen Holdings, Shenwuye A, and Tianjian Group hitting the limit up. The innovative drug concept pulled up, with Lummy Pharmaceutical, Hongbo Medical, Jianfeng Group, and Zhongheng Group hitting the limit up. On the decline, PCB concept stocks adjusted, with Sihui Fuji falling more than 10%. More stocks rose than fell, with more than 4,800 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets advancing, and half-day turnover of 971 billion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.95%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.19%, and ChiNext rose 0.96%. 2.
